text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Takarazuka Kinen,
Vivlos ramped up her training even further.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy,
what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *Thump thump.*

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yay~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Adding more weight to the bench press~♡

Vivlos has become mentally stable,
and her body has grown too.
We still need to be careful with her condition, though...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my!
My girl is looking pretty good, isn't she~?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer-san!
Pardon me while you're in the middle of training!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huhh! Mama and Papa~!?
What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Long time no see, Vivlos!
—I brought some refreshments!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos,
over here."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Not you too, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Anpan and rice balls for nutritional snacks...
Our team's trainer taught me about these,
so I brought over some good ones!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
And our stadium's
famous stadium food too!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
I brought your favorite dishes, too.
I thought eating them would cheer you up!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, I'll leave the choice
up to you and Vivlos-chan."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey,
I'm so super happy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy, but...
What brought this on so suddenly?"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
We mothers wanted to do something too~
After watching you girls in the Victoria Mile—

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: Both of you showed us a race where you pushed each other to greater heights, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Mom used to run in races too, so...
I understand just how incredible you two are.
And how hard you worked...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: "And yet, all Mom and the others ever do is work..."

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: —The children are growing so much, it'd be such a waste not to watch over them up close!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Just like during the Shuka Sho,
I want to watch you all from even closer!"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Forgive my tardiness! However...
Allow me to lend my strength to you hard-working folks!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mom, Dad...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: They said they'll both try to drop by and check in on us whenever they have a break from work.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any particular goals after this either...
So I'll support you all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean the whole family
gets to be together for a while!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnngh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
What about Cheva-chi!?
Isn't she here?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"She said she prefers to be on her own.
Don't worry, though. She'll be fine."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: This is what I was keeping safe for you.

What Verxina handed to Vivlos
was a cute charm designed after a freshly caught fish.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Could this be...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, isn't that charm super cute?
Let's get matching ones, Cheval-chi♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I won't...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
I see!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
thank you so much for doing this for me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to make everyone smile,
no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainy,
I've got a favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —...Phaaah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, this is delicious...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Mom, guys...
You really didn't need to do my share...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Vivlos's...
...U-Um, is there something...?
choice_data_list: Vivlos left a gift with me for you

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: From Vivlos...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Please pass this along to Cheval-chi!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"See, these are tickets for an ultra-rare cruise!
I worked super hard to get 'em!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It's the kind of vibe you can enjoy even on your own, so I thought it might help you unwind, Schva-chi!
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to give it to them yourself and go together?
Aren't you going to give it to them yourself and go together?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I think Cheval-chi just wants
to focus on her own for a bit."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to get in Cheval-chi's way
when she's trying so hard!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm too clingy,
she might not like it, so..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Even though she's usually so pushy,
she suddenly pulls back at the weirdest times.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: No... it's my fault, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...But—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I thought about adding this to the charm...
but I decided against it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“Still...
Please... make sure she gets this.”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Is this from Cheval-chi?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainy!
choice_data_list: She's still out on the track!
She's still out on the track, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you so much~~!

The letter handed to me by Cheval Grand contained just a single sentence: "Let's both do our best."
...Yet, it seemed more than enough to bind the sisters together.
